rounds.text: The long-term growth narrative of Last Mile Enterprises Ltd is fundamentally broken, as evidenced by the catastrophic collapse in sales performance [E14, E15, E16]. While the company once achieved 70% compounded sales growth over a decade, this has reversed into a 38% decline over three years and a staggering 61% contraction in the trailing twelve months [E14, E15, E16]. This downward trajectory is further underscored by an abysmal return on assets of 2.95%, which fails to reach even half of the 7.1% sector benchmark [E8]. Investors are paying a premium P/E of 35.9 for a business that is currently shrinking at an accelerating rate [E1, E16]. Conceded: [E2, E6, E7, E14, E47, E58, E67]. The company’s inability to maintain its historical growth pace suggests that the current valuation is disconnected from its deteriorating operational reality [E1, E16].
